input: Research noise ordinance rules before the block party

gold.taskTitle: Research Noise Ordinance Rules Before Block Party
gold.taskDescription: Research the local noise ordinance rules that apply to an upcoming block party event.

questions.title: What city or county is the block party in?
questions.description: Identify the specific municipality whose noise ordinance rules apply.

questions.title: What date is the block party scheduled for?
questions.description: Confirm the exact date to determine day-of-week rules and any seasonal restrictions.

questions.title: What time will the party start and end?
questions.description: Establish the planned hours to check against permitted noise windows.

questions.title: What type of noise are you most concerned about?
questions.description: Determine whether the concern is live music, a DJ, loudspeakers, crowd noise, or something else.

questions.title: Have you already applied for a block party permit?
questions.description: Understand whether a permit is in progress, already granted, or not yet started, as it may affect noise allowances.

questions.title: Who is leading this research -- you or a committee?
questions.description: Clarify who is responsible so the plan can be assigned and communicated correctly.

questions.title: Do you need to formally notify or contact local authorities?
questions.description: Determine whether the goal is passive research only or includes reaching out to city officials or non-emergency police lines.
